title: Mixing games MHW x Skyrim? Just wondering if AI can.
author: Smooth_Rutabaga4635
selftext: Essentially what’s in the title, just wondering if it’s possible at this stage to blend the two. My personal dream game would be an Open world RPG with Monster Hunter Monsters, animations and Assets mixed with Skyrims player housing and quests etc. just would like to know if it’s worth trying from people who know a lot more than myself. Cheers in advance!

replies.author: Smooth_Rutabaga4635
replies.body: Sorry, super new to this. Pretty much only seen reels of cod and skate being spliced together, what are tokens?

replies.author: BoringPossum
replies.body: The thing that gets consumed when you use Claude to do things. Basically the cod and skate mashups are reverse engineered versions of the games translated to same ai friendly engine and then combined.

replies.author: Smooth_Rutabaga4635
replies.body: So it would simply be a matter of investing into it? That’s good to know. Would I then be able to mod the game through creation kit normally? Asking purely because I have a little knowledge on how it runs, I’d build my own base and then put Elder Dragons in as boss monsters. Maybe even Dark Souls Bosses etc, either way that’s super helpful so thanks even if you aren’t fully sure

comments.author: Shuttmedia
comments.body:
Not yet, someday probably in the next few years but not yet unless you have some knowledge of how the systems work, despite what this sub might say haha. I mean you can just browse the sub to see what’s been made to know we are still ways out from that

One of the most difficult parts of that is that it’s not just the dev side, it’s the ideas and processing how every item, upgrade, stats mix with each other and thinking of the myriad of different combinations players will use (usually done by a big team for these games)

replies.author: Smooth_Rutabaga4635
replies.body: Oh my bad I should have elaborated a bit more. I don’t want the all of the systems integrated In their entirety. I meant more like have a lodge, hunt a Nergigante and hangs its skeleton in the rafters, static assets like a Hammer from the game that just functions like a hammer without the wide upgrade branches etc. having the animations to match the assets would be cool, but not the full crafting system and upgrade paths. Essentially just merge assets, animations and monsters. Not sure if that changes anything but if it does I’d still like to know.

replies.author: Shuttmedia
replies.body:
Something smaller like that where it’s more of a concept of a game than an actual game then yes you could.  
It’s quite easy to get concepts out the issue is trying to make them into a game that people would play more than an hour

replies.author: Smooth_Rutabaga4635
replies.body: That’s fair, in this particular case it’s more so for myself if I’m honest. I’d like to play an Open World RPG with Monster Hunter Monsters and Assets with some cool combat animations and a trophy hall, maybe even a small guild quest line to hunt them. If AI could help me achieve that I’d do it, and if other people wanna play it later that’s cool too. But yeah, I’m not really into the whole branching upgrades, give me an open world to explore, giant Weapons to hack at stuff with and cool monsters and bosses with a bit of storyline to keep me on the right path I’m sold.
